text:
maya: Heads up — ClearSky Labs submitted an invoice (INV-2026-0412) but payment is on hold. Vendor also sent a bank account update in the same thread. :frowning:

jordan: @maya can you paste the PO on the invoice? I can try to match it.

maya: PO on invoice = PO-778355 (looks like the one that was canceled last quarter)

sam: Hi all, from vendor side — invoice was reissued after we merged accounts. They say PO should have been PO-884200, but their AP team used the legacy PO by mistake. They also submitted new bank details:

```
Old account: CLEAR-ACCT-1234
New account: CLEAR-ACCT-5678 (routing updated 03/24)
```

alex: tagging procurement? The PO mismatch + bank change flags AML/process rules. approvals-bot usually prevents payment when PO != matching vendor record.

approvals-bot: Payment hold applied: reason=PO_MISMATCH; required_actions=[attach_correct_po, vendor_kba, approver_routing]

jordan: Ok — two separate issues: 1) PO number mismatch, 2) unverified bank change. We need procurement to confirm which PO to link and vendor success to verify new account.

maya: Procurement is on PTO today. Can we route temporary approver to the Platform cost center? This invoice is for infra usage (GPU credits) and will start incurring late fees if not paid in next run.

sam: We can provide vendor-side signed amendment confirming the new account and the reason for PO difference. Will send in 30m.

alex: If Platform can vouch and provide GL/charge code, finance can temporarily approve with conditional hold until procurement sign-off. Suggest GL 5401-infra and cost center "platform-prod".

jordan: I can do a manual override if Maya adds a comment with the GL and flags it as "platform temporary approval". But need clear audit trail. Please include the vendor amendment PDF and a short note.

maya: Adding note now: "Platform confirmed this invoice = GPU infra usage for March; GL 5401-infra; temporary routing to Jordan for payment run. Vendor amendment attached (will upload)." :white_check_mark:

sam: Uploaded amendment and vendor bank verification (W9 equivalent). Link: https://files.clearsky.example/INV-2026-0412-amend.pdf

approvals-bot: Document attached. Pending: procurement confirmation OR 2-level finance sign-off.

jordan: I submitted the manual override request to Treasury with reason "temporary platform route per Maya; vendor amendment attached". ETA for inclusion in next ACH batch = 48h.

maya: Thanks. One more ask — procurement needs to update the central PO record to reflect merged vendor accounts so this doesn't repeat. @alex can you follow up with procurement when they're back?

alex: Yup will open procurement ticket and CC @maya.

sam: Appreciate the quick help — vendor requested no further follow-ups, they just want to avoid payment delay.

maya: Noted. I'll monitor the batch and confirm once payment clears.

jordan: If Treasury rejects manual override, we'll escalate to Finance Lead for emergency sign-off.

maya: End state for thread: vendor amendment + bank verification attached; platform GL added; manual override requested; approvals-bot hold updated. Will update when payment clears.

sam: Thanks everyone :pray:
_meta: Slack thread exported: vendor invoice with PO mismatch + bank change; contains root message + replies in chronological order
